evals.name: missing_companion_skill
evals.prompt: Create visual concepts for this new dashboard. The companion HTML skill is not installed.
expect: Requests approval for that exact installation before it changes project or global state
Continues with the local semantic and accessibility rules if installation is not approved

evals.name: image_generation_unavailable
evals.prompt: Design a landing page, but this environment has no image-generation capability.
expect: States that image generation is not available
Provides prompt-ready concept briefs without claiming that it generated images
Requests confirmation before it continues with text-only planning

evals.name: approved_direction_boundary
evals.prompt: I already supplied and approved the design. Implement this small component change.
expect: Does not restart three-concept visual exploration
Uses the approved design as the authoritative reference
Keeps the work proportional to the requested component change
